sloka: सा सेना शीघ्रमागच्छच्छ्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नशासनम् ।निवेशनं च शत्रुघ्नः श्रावणेन समारभत् ।। ७.७०.८ ॥
transliteration: sā senā śīghramāgacchacchrutvā śatrughnaśāsanam ।niveśanaṁ ca śatrughnaḥ śrāvaṇena samārabhat ।। 7.70.8 ॥

translations.english: That army quickly arrived upon hearing Shatrughna's command, and Shatrughna began the establishment of the city in the month of Shravana.
